places.quote: a few months after your departure for Ingolstadt, Justine was called home by her repentant mother
places.note: Victor is at Ingolstadt during the narrated scene; the letter is addressed to him there.

places.quote: Now, dear Victor, I dare say you wish to be indulged in a little gossip concerning the good people of Geneva.
places.note: Named in Elizabeth's letter, which is headed "Geneva, March 18th"; the narrated scene itself is set elsewhere.
